name: Peach sparkle tutu dress
description2: Designed to keep little ones comfy while they shine, it is fully lined with soft fabric inside so the sequins never scratch. The piece comes complete with a matching peach flower-and-pearl crown headband for an effortless, picture-perfect look.

specs.fabric: Silver sequin body with a layered net tutu skirt
specs.fit: Fitted sleeveless sequin top with a fluffy, high-volume net tutu skirt

description: A show-stopping party dress featuring an all-over shimmering silver sequin bodice paired with a playful, high-volume peach net tutu skirt. The waistline is accented with a delicate peach 3D floral corsage that ties the sparkling silver and soft pastel tones together beautifully.
